releases.notes:
# Stash-Hunter 26.2.1 — The Big Stability & Performance Update

Your stash-hunting bot now flies faster, finds more stashes, and crashes less.

## What's new

### 🛡️ Stability — the bot stays alive
- Death, dimension changes and leaving the server now cleanly reset the flight —
  no more flying to stale coordinates after a respawn.
- Elytra repair no longer aborts mid-flight or hangs for 300 s without XP.
- The built-in controller and Baritone no longer fight each other.

### ⚡ Performance — no more stutter
- Chunk-packet work moved off the Netty connection thread (`mc.execute`).
- File writes are batched; rendering no longer allocates per frame; the O(n³)
  trail search is capped.
- `scanForBlocks` is significantly faster (palette skipping, one distance check).

### 🎯 Scan correctness — finds more stashes
- **Biggest fix:** while flying, stashes *below* the bot were never found (the old
  spherical radius). Scans are now a full-height cylinder — Nether roof, the End
  and mountains included.
- Containers are no longer double-counted; neighbouring stashes are no longer
  merged; close stashes are no longer discarded.
- The same stash is no longer re-reported every 10 minutes, and waypoints now
  carry the correct dimension.

### 🌐 Discord & config
- Webhook now honours rate limits (429), retries with backoff, and bounds its queue.
- `@everyone` is opt-in (`mention-everyone`, default off).
- Config saves are debounced (no more dozens of writes per slider drag).

### 🧹 Cleaned up & modernized
- Fabric API is no longer required — Meteor's `GameLeftEvent` replaces the old
  disconnect hook.
- Dead code removed (WorldScanner, Logger, Utils, unused mixins).
- Core logic extracted into tested classes: **17 unit tests**, Spotless, Dependabot.

## New settings
- `mention-everyone`, `max-cluster-size`, `report-dedupe-radius`

## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**, Fabric Loader **0.20.1**, Meteor Client **26.2**

## ⚠️ Note
This release is not yet fully tested in-game — please verify on a test server.

releases.notes:
## Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3** or newer, Fabric API **0.160.0+26.2**
- Meteor Client **26.2**
- Java **25**

## New
- Runs on Minecraft 26.2 with the latest Meteor Client.
- **Auto Elytra Repair:** the `notify-repairs` setting now sends Discord messages when a repair starts, finishes or fails.

## Fixes
- **No more freezes from Discord notifications:** webhooks are now sent in the background with a timeout. Before, a slow or unreachable Discord could freeze the game.
- **NewerNewChunks now detects chunks:** chunk detection never ran before, so trail following during flight had no data to work with.
- **First waypoint no longer skipped:** the bot now flies the first strip properly instead of cutting across it diagonally.
- **Auto Elytra Repair works with Stash Hunter again:** the two modules weren't talking to each other at all.
- **Jumping works again while Stash Hunter is on:** the jump key was being released every tick. This also stopped the Altitude Loss Detector and Stuck Detector auto-fixes from working.
- **Stuck Detector** now uses its own webhook URL and no longer changes the game from a background thread (a possible cause of crashes).
- **Auto Elytra Repair:**
  - Can no longer crash when a Meteor setting it reads is missing.
  - Returning to flight after a repair no longer spams key presses.
  - After a repair it climbs to your configured flight altitude instead of a fixed Y=200.
- **No false alerts:** "Bot Respawned" is no longer sent every time the module is turned on, and seeing the same player again after they leave render distance no longer triggers a duplicate alert.
- **Correct stash coordinates at extreme distances:** stashes very far out (millions of blocks) no longer get wrong coordinates.
- **NewerNewChunks** no longer errors when turned on from the main menu.
- Fixed a startup crash on 26.2.

## Changed behaviour — please check
- **Flight now reacts to new chunks:** because detection works now, the bot may avoid new chunks or follow chunk trails during flight. Turn off `dynamic-trail-detection` in NewerNewChunks if you don't want that.
- **Lower climb height after repairs:** after a repair the bot climbs to your `flight-altitude` setting (default 160) instead of Y=200.
